text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, Vodka? I'm the queen.
You lost, so you've got no complaints, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gwoh... Today of all days, I really wanted to win! In a totally different sense than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Fine, whatever... All right, Your Majesty,
go on and give me your orders!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Once we get back to the room today, maybe I'll have you do ALL the chores.
Cleaning up, preparing meals...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: With a frilly maid apron, of course♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaaat!?
I don't wanna do that, no wayyyy!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you seriously make me do that, I'm running away from home!
I'll hop on my bike and never come back!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: My, you look like you hate it from the bottom of your heart.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. Maybe I'll choose something else.
Alright, this one then.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you stay my rival forever,
from now on, too...!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, and the time after that, you better not run away
and race me, okay? Got it?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-What? Why are you staying quiet?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Don't just say something that serious out of nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I changed it because you said you didn't want it, dammit!!

Daiwa Scarlet unleashed a barrage of furious kicks into Vodka.
It seems someone touched a royal nerve.
